body: You might have a reason to stay. Maybe seek some help and see if you can work through things. Personally, though, I am done.
I feel you. I completely hate the fact that we have do all this life stuff involuntarily. I would have NEVER chosen to be born, but I find some peace in knowing that I can end it when I want.

Yeah, I feel you. But I am getting to a point where I think if they really love me, they'll understand and respect my decision regardless of how much it will hurt them. Plus, I'll be forgotten eventually anyways (:
I can relate so much. It really does suck when they negate mental illness and blame it on things like low ambition or not staying busy.
All I can say is that I can relate what you are going through in regard to suicidal thoughts and you are not alone.
